title: The Spilled Ink
scene: At 10:15 PM, the press ink tank was emptied onto the floor. The press room was locked for the 10:00 edition.

suspects.name: Ruth Kade
suspects.testimony: I was proofing the front page in the newsroom at 10:15.
suspects.alibiProof: The newsroom markup shows Ruth's initials at 10:14 and 10:19.

suspects.name: Abel Fenn
suspects.testimony: I was changing the rolls on press two from 10:05 to 10:25.
suspects.alibiProof: The press counter logged Abel's badge at 10:06 and 10:24.

suspects.name: Nia Cole
suspects.testimony: I was filing a story from the cafe next door at 10:15.
suspects.alibiProof: Nia's draft saved from the cafe network at 10:13.

suspects.name: Victor Hale
suspects.testimony: I was patrolling the lobby at 10:15, far from the press room.
suspects.contradiction: The lobby camera never shows Victor after 9:58, and ink stains mark his flashlight grip.
